This app collects your device location, including when the app is closed or not in use, to keep your connected study device (e.g. Bluetooth wearable) reachable and to record location samples for the research study you consented to. Location data is uploaded to the study server you agreed to. Tap Accept to be asked by Android for the "Allow all the time" location permission.
You can revoke this permission at any time from Android Settings.
